mapper.select: select c.discrepancy_case_id, c.case_version as case_version_before, a.adjudication_id, x.adjudication_action_id, x.execution_version as action_version_before, c.discrepancy_type, x.action_type, parent.transfer_id as parent_transfer_id, parent.transfer_type as parent_transfer_type, parent.from_dept_id, parent.from_warehouse_id, parent.to_dept_id, parent.to_warehouse_id, parent.return_reason_code, parent.return_reason_text, ra.receipt_allocation_id, sa.allocation_id as shipment_allocation_id, ra.item_type, ra.item_id, ra.product_id, ra.tracking_policy, x.action_quantity, a.source_cost_price, x.action_amount, a.decision_fingerprint from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_case c inner join inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication a on a.discrepancy_case_id = c.discrepancy_case_id and a.adjudication_id = #{adjudicationId} inner join inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication_action x on x.discrepancy_case_id = c.discrepancy_case_id and x.adjudication_id = a.adjudication_id and x.adjudication_action_id = #{actionId} inner join inv_transfer_shipment_receipt_allocation ra on ra.receipt_allocation_id = c.receipt_allocation_id and ra.receipt_id = c.receipt_id and ra.shipment_id = c.shipment_id and ra.shipment_allocation_id = c.shipment_allocation_id inner join inv_transfer_shipment_allocation sa on sa.allocation_id = c.shipment_allocation_id and sa.shipment_id = c.shipment_id and sa.transfer_id = c.transfer_id and sa.allocation_id = ra.shipment_allocation_id inner join inv_transfer_order parent on parent.transfer_id = c.transfer_id where c.discrepancy_case_id = #{caseId} and c.case_version = #{caseVersion} and c.discrepancy_type = 'shortage' and c.discrepancy_quantity = ra.shortage_quantity and c.source_cost_price = ra.cost_price and c.discrepancy_amount = round(c.discrepancy_quantity * c.source_cost_price, 6) and a.case_version_after <= c.case_version and a.discrepancy_type = c.discrepancy_type and a.discrepancy_quantity = c.discrepancy_quantity and a.source_cost_price = c.source_cost_price and a.discrepancy_amount = c.discrepancy_amount and a.plan_status in ( 'adjudication_planned', 'adjudication_executing') and c.status = a.plan_status and x.action_type = 'reship' and x.coverage_kind = 'resolution' and x.action_quantity > 0 and x.action_quantity <= c.discrepancy_quantity and x.action_amount = round(x.action_quantity * c.source_cost_price, 6) and x.action_amount <= c.discrepancy_amount and x.execution_status = 'pending' and x.execution_version = #{actionVersion} and x.execution_effect_reference is null and ra.item_type in ('product', 'oe', 'gift') and ra.item_id > 0 and ra.tracking_policy in ('lot', 'serial') and ra.shortage_quantity > 0 and sa.transfer_detail_id = ra.transfer_detail_id and sa.cost_price = ra.cost_price and parent.transfer_type in ( 'warehouse', 'store_return', 'cross_store') and not exists ( select 1 from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_adjudication_workflow_link link where link.adjudication_action_id = x.adjudication_action_id ) for update

select child.transfer_id, child.transfer_type, child.source_business_type, child.source_business_id, coalesce(nullif(child.from_warehouse_id, 0), child.from_dept_id) as source_location_dept_id, coalesce(nullif(child.to_warehouse_id, 0), child.to_dept_id) as target_location_dept_id, child.status, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_detail all_detail where all_detail.transfer_id = child.transfer_id) as detail_count, detail.item_type, detail.item_id, detail.product_id, detail.quantity as requested_quantity, detail.delivered_quantity, 'available_stock' as reservation_kind, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_reservation all_reservation where all_reservation.transfer_id = child.transfer_id and all_reservation.reservation_round = child.approval_round) as reservation_count, (select coalesce(sum(all_reservation.reserved_quantity), 0) from inv_transfer_reservation all_reservation where all_reservation.transfer_id = child.transfer_id and all_reservation.reservation_round = child.approval_round) as reserved_quantity, reservation.status as reservation_status, reservation.consumed_quantity, reservation.released_quantity, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_shipment v2_shipment where v2_shipment.transfer_id = child.transfer_id and v2_shipment.inventory_write_version = 'V2_DETAIL') as v2_shipment_count, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_shipment legacy_shipment where legacy_shipment.transfer_id = child.transfer_id and coalesce(legacy_shipment.inventory_write_version, 'LEGACY') <> 'V2_DETAIL') as legacy_shipment_count, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_shipment_receipt receipt where receipt.transfer_id = child.transfer_id) as receipt_count, (select count(1) from inv_transfer_receipt_discrepancy_case discrepancy where discrepancy.transfer_id = child.transfer_id and discrepancy.status <> 'resolved') as open_discrepancy_count from inv_transfer_order child inner join inv_transfer_detail detail on detail.detail_id = ( select min(first_detail.detail_id) from inv_transfer_detail first_detail where first_detail.transfer_id = child.transfer_id) inner join inv_transfer_reservation reservation on reservation.reservation_id = ( select min(first_reservation.reservation_id) from inv_transfer_reservation first_reservation where first_reservation.transfer_id = child.transfer_id and first_reservation.reservation_round = child.approval_round) where child.transfer_id = #{childTransferId} and child.source_business_type = 'transfer_discrepancy_reship' and child.source_business_id = #{actionId} and child.approval_round > 0 and reservation.transfer_detail_id = detail.detail_id and reservation.item_type = detail.item_type and reservation.item_id = detail.item_id and reservation.source_location_dept_id = coalesce( nullif(child.from_warehouse_id, 0), child.from_dept_id) and reservation.status = 'ACTIVE' and reservation.consumed_quantity = 0 and reservation.released_quantity = 0 for update
